description: Data-analyst additions to the global sensitive-fields list. The effective list is the union of this file and packages/schema/sensitive_fields.json. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes over field name, id, label, placeholder, autocomplete and aria-label. Role-depth additions (7 Nov 2026): row-level identifiers and personal columns that show up in profile and lineage panels. Finding editors, metric descriptions and review boxes are deliberately NOT listed: the capture never reads their text, and listing them would drop the events that make WRITE_FINDING, DOCUMENT_METRIC and PEER_CHECK visible.
